==Description==
'''X-000''' will be the entity that appears once you run out of time with the '''Clocks Ticking''' Modifier, it being a run ender if spawned

==Mechanics==
Once the player fails to add time to the clock and it reaches 000, '''X-000''' will spawn, making the atmosphere red and chasing the player from behind, being able to be seen/going through walls, it will kill the player once it reaches them.

==Strategies==
* Open doors to add to the clock
** if you fail, you are dead, there is no surviving '''Father Death'''.
*** this means that, unlike Haste from DOORS, once '''X-000''' is active, there is no way to deactivate him

==Trivia==
'''X-000''' was originally going to be '''E-000'''
